description:
Applies one explicit atomic session batch with a caller-persisted operation ID.
Use when: reporting completed session counters, or retrying exactly the same durable ID and payload after an uncertain timeout.
Not for: automatically generating another ID for a failed/unknown outcome, or one HTTP call per counter.
Requires: userId and the player's session: sign in with horizon_signin_email or horizon_signin_anonymous and pass its accessToken as sessionToken. Persist the original operationId and unchanged updates before sending. ID is <13-digit Unix milliseconds>:<UUID>; use the snapshot server operation time for clock alignment.
Side effects: Updates all counters atomically. A retained same-ID same-payload receipt replays; changed payload conflicts. Eight receipts and a persistent eviction floor can reject delayed out-of-order unknown IDs even within 24 hours; nothing is rebooked.
Returns: The current statistics snapshot with operationId and replayed.
Errors: 401 SESSION_REQUIRED: sign in again; 403 SESSION_FORBIDDEN: use the matching player. 409 OPERATION_CONFLICT means the ID was already used for a different payload. 410 OPERATION_EXPIRED rejects an expired/evicted unknown ID. Never replace an uncertain ID automatically. 422 UNKNOWN_STATISTIC/UPDATE_ABOVE_LIMIT/VALUE_OVERFLOW rejects the whole batch. Needs HORIZON_API_KEY. Every failure returns an error result (isError) with the HTTP status and body: a 401 that horizon_test_connection also returns means HORIZON_API_KEY is wrong, 429 means the account's per-minute rate limit was reached (wait a minute, then retry).

operationId.description: Original durable <13-digit Unix milliseconds>:<UUID> operation ID; reuse unchanged on retry

sessionToken.description: Player accessToken from horizon_signin_anonymous or horizon_signin_email; sent as Bearer

updates.description: Original immutable batch of distinct statistic keys with safe integer values; server enforces the current System Config definition limit, which can exceed tier defaults

userId.description: Signed-in player UUID matching the supplied session token

name: horizon_update_statistics
title: Update Player Statistics Batch
